strategy.name: Illustrative proof campaign
assumptions: Illustrative format example, not a computed forecast or real campaign.

reasons: Illustrates selection by tenth-percentile contribution profit.
tradeoffs: Conservative does not mean guaranteed safe; this format example still shows a probability of loss.

warnings: Synthetic round-number example only; these values were not produced by an executed simulation.
Only one distinct candidate is available in this example.

definitions.contribution_profit: Purchases times contribution per purchase minus campaign spend.
definitions.roi: Expected contribution profit divided by campaign spend; a ratio.
definitions.acquisition_cost: Campaign spend divided by expected purchases; null at zero purchases.
definitions.range: Tenth, median and ninetieth scenario profit percentiles, not confidence bounds.
definitions.probability_of_loss: Simulated fraction with negative contribution profit, conditional on assumptions.

assumptions: All values are synthetic and illustrative. Contribution per purchase in this example is USD 55.
